program.help:
Estimate spatial probe drift from curated spike-sorting results.
Must be run AFTER spike sorting (ndm_klustakwik) and manual curation in Klusters. Requires .res.N, .clu.N, and (for full accuracy) .spk.N files for each spike group.
The plugin reads the curated cluster files and, using the electrode site geometry from the .probe configuration files declared in the session YAML, computes the waveform centre-of-mass (CoM) for each well-isolated unit on each shank. By tracking how those CoM positions shift over successive time windows, the algorithm estimates the in-vivo drift of each probe shank in micrometres.
The result is written to SESSION.drift (YAML format) and can be used to: - Visualise drift trajectories in a companion tool - Flag sessions with excessive drift (>10–15 µm/h) for re-analysis - Provide correction parameters for post-hoc spike re-assignment
OUTPUT FILE SESSION.drift drift: format: '1.0' method: unit_com windowSec: 60.0 probes: - probeId: 0 shanks: - shankIndex: 0 spikeGroup: 1 nUnitsTotal: 8 refCom_um: 245.3 windows: - { t_start: 0.0, t_end: 60.0, drift_um: 0.0, com_um: 245.3 } - { t_start: 60.0, t_end: 120.0, drift_um: -1.8, com_um: 243.5 }
OPTIONAL PARAMETERS
# windowSec Time window length in seconds for drift computation (default = 60). Shorter windows give finer temporal resolution but require more spikes/unit.
# minUnits Minimum number of well-isolated units per shank required to compute drift (default = 3). Shanks with fewer good units are skipped.
# minSpikes Minimum number of spikes a unit must fire in a given window to be included in the CoM computation for that window (default = 20).
# excludeNoise If true (default), excludes cluster 0 (artifact/noise) and cluster 1 (MUA) from the CoM calculation. Set to false to include MUA.
# probeLibrary Override the probe library search path. By default the plugin searches: $NEUROSUITE_PROBE_PATH, ~/.local/share/neurosuite/probes/, /usr/share/neurosuite/probes/, and ./probes/ (session-local).
